full_judgment: 3. The pre-emptee no.1 appeared and contested the case on filing written objection stating, inter-alia, that originally the government of Bangladesh was the owner of 2.00 acres of land of "hal" plot no. 1474. Thereafter one Fazlur Rahaman took "pattan" of the said property. While he was possessing the same his name was duly recorded in R.S. record. Thereafter one A. Mannan Bakaul and A. Rashid Bakaul purchased 02 acre of land in equal Share and was owning and possessing the same in ejmah. Subsequently, A. Mannan Bakaul transferred 66 decimals of land to his wife Khurshida and nephew Babul pre-emptee no.1 purchased the suit land for an amount of Tk. 50,000/=. But at the time of registry, the scribe mentioned the value of Tk.30,000/=. That the pre-emptor having no title and possession alleging concocted and false story brought this petition for pre-emption. That the pre-emptor is also not a co-sharer by purchase in the suit land and that he is not a tenant of adjacent land, hence, the petition is liable to be rejected.
